# BioPlausiblePredictiveCoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computational paradigm where neural circuits generate predictions of sensory inputs and compute prediction errors, inspired by cortical microcircuits. Enables energy-efficient, event-driven processing that aligns with neuromorphic hardware constraints, crucial for in-network intelligence and low-latency adaptation.
